rationale: The legacy 8.8 offerings/setup locators now redirect to current agent pages. The offerings table keeps Premier Cloud/Cloud Connected, paired SOAR, representative enablement and Cloud Platform 10.2.x+/ES 8.6+. Both 8.7 and 8.8 setup say Cloud Platform 10.2+/ES 8.7+. Current 8.8 setup separates CMP Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0; requires assistant enablement, inherited connector access and role/asset controls, frontier models and existing findings with the documented finding limits. The region/edition tables are scoped context and do not prove an exact pairing or component entitlement. Current release notes give November 4 GA; the registered historical Controlled Availability section and original Triage edition wording were not independently recovered.

exclusions: Exact pairing, agent rollout, entitlement and authorization are separate. Current Cloud discrepancy remains.
